Watermark

  • Security - Watermark

Security - Watermark

[Add]：Create a new watermark template

Dynamic Watermark Function: Multiple watermark templates can be set for different personnel.


[Edit]：Watermark Template design

  • Operation: In the Design section, the Watermark Object can be directly dragged, rotated, and resized using the mouse.

  • Watermark Object：System parameters provided for watermark use:

    • Account

    • Printer

    • Date

    • Time

    • Computer Name

    • Owner (FUJFILM only)

  • Watermark Style：Provide font variations for the watermark.

    • font

    • fontSize

    • Color Depth

    • Outline

    • Rotate

    • Char Width

    • Char Height
